description: This source file defines an immutable singleton class `ImmutableRequestPlaceholder` that implements the `Placeholder<AuthorizationContext>` interface. The class provides methods to support request-related placeholders such as 'subjectId' by resolving data from an `AuthorizationContext`. It is part of the package `org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders` and includes logic to support authorization context placeholders in a system related to authorization and request processing.

classes.name: ImmutableRequestPlaceholder
classes.description: A singleton immutable class that provides placeholder support for request-related data based on an AuthorizationContext, supporting the 'subjectId' placeholder.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix string 'request' used for the placeholder.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list of supported placeholder names, currently only 'subjectId'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a given placeholder name is supported ('subjectId').

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder value (e.g., subject ID) from the given AuthorizationContext.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the class.
